reason: Harness 1.0 removes the 0.x deprecation shims (#12997): `pydantic_ai_harness.shell._capability`, Shell.__init__(tools): Parameter kind was changed: positional or keyword -> keyword-only. Each removed path emitted a `HarnessDeprecationWarning` naming its replacement during 0.x. `Shell` and `FileSystem` options are keyword-only so an old positional call fails instead of shifting.
